descriptor.retrieval_description: Paperback book with stiff paper cover. The intended contact region is clean, dry, flat, and parallel on opposing lateral faces.
descriptor.contact_region: Opposing lateral faces of the book cover
descriptor.local_geometry: Flat, broad parallel surfaces with perpendicular edges at the spine and fore-edge
